tasks.title: Modify index.ts
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/server/index.ts. Accept explicit server scope and clean up owned effects on close and failed startup. FR-002, FR-003. Tests: src/server/server-scope.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Scoped startup SQLite probe — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/server/index.ts:245-252
  EXPECTED: Scoped startup uses only the supplied SQLite connection for persistence.
  ACTUAL: new PlanHeartbeat(config, slackApp, projectRoot) starts a PlanStore with no connection. A startup probe opened the default SQLite path even with options.ledger supplied.
  FIX: Pass scoped persistence to the heartbeat and any startup service that queries SQLite. Keep default behavior for unscoped callers. Run the real heartbeat in a test that rejects default database access.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/server/index.ts — Pass `options.ledger` to `PlanHeartbeat` and `HarvestWatcher`. In `src/server/heartbeat.ts` and `src/server/harvest-watcher.ts`, add `import type { DispatchLedgerScope } from "./dispatch.js"` and an optional `ledger?: DispatchLedgerScope` constructor argument. Use the supplied project ID and connection for `PlanStore`, `getCompressionRecord` and all SQLite calls reached through `src/engine/harvest.ts`. Keep the existing defaults when `ledger` is absent. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, run and await the real startup heartbeat. Make `getDb` a throwing `vi.fn` and assert zero calls so caught errors still fail the test. Exercise the watcher with a terminal pull request and a matching scoped compression record. Verify the test fails before the fix and passes under `specs/046-hermetic-ci/gates/phase-01.sh` afterward.
FIX: src/server/dispatch.ts — Catch ship execution errors before calling `handleCompletion` exactly once. Set terminal dispatch and task state before `finishRun`. Use `finally` to destroy any worktree, release the active slot, journal the terminal record and advance the queue. Route `startRun` failures through the same cleanup. Retain ledger errors before removing settled promises from `inFlight`. Make `DispatchQueue.close()` drain all in-flight work and reject with the retained errors. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, add a `BEFORE UPDATE ON runs` trigger with `RAISE(ABORT, 'fixture ledger update failed')`. Wait for teardown before closing. Assert terminal journal state, zero active slots, removal from disk and `git worktree list`, and rejection from `app.close()` containing the trigger error. Verify the test fails before the fix and passes under `specs/046-hermetic-ci/gates/phase-01.sh` afterward.
FIX: tests/helpers/server-fixture.ts — Build a fresh child environment in `fixtureGit`. Remove the keys reported by `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` before every fixture Git call, including `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`, `GIT_COMMON_DIR`, `GIT_INDEX_FILE` and the object-directory selectors. Keep the existing noninteractive settings. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, set `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE` to a second temporary repository before creating a dispatch fixture in `"routes"` mode. Assert the fixture has its own `.git` and `Initialize fixture` commit. Assert the second repository’s HEAD, status and local config remain unchanged. Restore the environment and clean up both roots in `finally`. Verify the test fails before the fix and passes under `specs/046-hermetic-ci/gates/phase-01.sh` afterward.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/server/index.ts — Pass `options.ledger` to `PlanHeartbeat` and `HarvestWatcher`. In `src/server/heartbeat.ts` and `src/server/harvest-watcher.ts`, add `import type { DispatchLedgerScope } from "./dispatch.js"` and accept `ledger?: DispatchLedgerScope`. Pass the scoped `projectId` and `db` to `PlanStore`, `getCompressionRecord` and every SQLite call reached through `harvestFeature` in `src/engine/harvest.ts`. Use the existing defaults when the scope is absent. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, await the real startup heartbeat and watcher. Supply terminal pull requests with both harvested and pending scoped records. Assert that the throwing `getDb` mock receives zero calls and that pending harvest writes land in the scoped database.
FIX: src/server/dispatch.ts — Catch ship execution errors before calling `handleCompletion` once. Set terminal dispatch and task state before `finishRun`. Route `startRun` failures through the same completion path. In `finally`, remove the worktree, release the active slot, journal terminal state and advance the queue. Retain ledger errors before deleting settled promises from `inFlight`. Make `DispatchQueue.close()` drain in-flight work before surfacing retained errors. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, add a `BEFORE UPDATE ON runs` trigger with `RAISE(ABORT, 'fixture ledger update failed')`. Before closing, assert terminal journal state, zero active slots and worktree removal from disk and `git worktree list --porcelain`. Assert that `app.close()` rejects with the trigger error.
FIX: tests/helpers/server-fixture.ts — In `fixtureGit`, copy `process.env` and remove every key returned by `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` before each fixture Git call. Run the discovery command with a clean environment and keep the noninteractive settings. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, point `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE` at a second repository before creating a `"routes"` fixture with `routes: ["dispatch"]`. Assert that the fixture owns its `.git` and `Initialize fixture` commit. Compare the second repository’s HEAD, porcelain status and local config before and after setup. Restore the environment and remove both roots in `finally`. Keep all three regressions in `specs/046-hermetic-ci/gates/phase-01.sh`. Verify each fails with its corresponding fix reverted and that the gate passes with all fixes applied.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Merged pull request harvest scope — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/engine/harvest.ts:335-345,380-386; src/engine/reconcile-gates.ts:79-91; src/engine/indicators.ts:18-24,68-72; src/server/integration.test.ts:395-418
  EXPECTED: Scoped harvest records gate evidence and compression in the fixture database. Indicator queries and task lookups use the fixture connection and project root.
  ACTUAL: reconcileGates(projectPath, featureId, phaseId) calls recordGateResult without the scoped connection. computeLeadingIndicators(featureId, forecast, projectId) calls getDb() and builds its task path from process.cwd(). The merged harvest test recorded two getDb calls.
  FIX: Pass the existing scope through gate reconciliation and indicator calculation. Preserve default behavior for unscoped callers. Run the merged harvest regression and verify the fixture holds gate evidence and compression.

POST-FLIGHT GATE FAIL (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh):
exit: 1
RUN  v3.2.4 /Users/gonzo/Code/gwrk-worktrees/hermetic-ci-plan/.runs/sandboxes/046-hermetic-ci-ship-182afd7d

stdout | src/engine/harvest.test.ts > FR-H10: Idempotency & FR-H09: Phase Completion > FR-H10: harvestFeature skips if already harvested (TC-H02, SC-H04)
Harvest already completed for test-feature phase-1, skipping.

stdout | src/engine/harvest.test.ts > FR-H10: Idempotency & FR-H09: Phase Completion > FR-H09: harvestFeature MUST verify all N sub-task PRs are merged before finalizing phas

REVIEW FAIL (code): Scoped GitHub webhook persistence — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/server/index.ts:223-228; src/server/github.ts:89-102,163-165
  EXPECTED: A signed issue event uses the server's supplied project ID and SQLite connection. Merged pull request harvest uses that same scope.
  ACTUAL: startServer registers githubWebhookPlugin with { config, projectRoot }. The handler calls upsertIssue(record, projectId) and harvestFeature(projectRoot, record) without scope. A signed labeled issue returned HTTP 500 after one getDb call and left zero issue rows in the fixture ledger.
  FIX: Pass options.ledger to githubWebhookPlugin. Use its project ID and connection for issue writes and pass the scope through to harvestFeature. Keep existing defaults for unscoped servers. Add signed webhook injection coverage with the default connection blocked.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/server/index.ts — Keep passing `options.ledger` to `PlanHeartbeat` and `HarvestWatcher`. In `src/server/heartbeat.ts` and `src/server/harvest-watcher.ts`, keep `import type { DispatchLedgerScope } from "./dispatch.js"` and `ledger?: DispatchLedgerScope`. Use its `projectId` and `db` for `PlanStore` and `getCompressionRecord`. Pass it through to `harvestFeature` and preserve unscoped defaults. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, await both real startup checks. Assert zero calls to the throwing `getDb` mock and verify the watcher skips an already harvested record and updates a pending record in fixture SQLite.
FIX: src/engine/harvest.ts — Keep passing `scope` to `reconcileGates(projectPath, featureId, phaseId, scope)`. In `src/engine/reconcile-gates.ts`, pass `scope?.db` and the resolved project ID to `recordGateResult`. In `src/engine/indicators.ts`, keep `projectRoot = process.cwd()` and `ledger?: Database.Database` as optional inputs. Call `computeLeadingIndicators(featureId, forecast, projectId, scope ? projectPath : undefined, scope?.db)`. Keep the merged watcher regression in `src/server/integration.test.ts` checking scoped gate evidence, compression and the fixture task count through a 50 percent first-pass rate.
FIX: src/server/github.ts — Add `import type { DispatchLedgerScope } from "./dispatch.js"` and `ledger?: DispatchLedgerScope` to `githubWebhookPlugin` options. Pass `options.ledger` at registration in `src/server/index.ts`. Use `ledger?.projectId ?? resolveProjectId(projectRoot)` and pass `ledger?.db` to both `upsertIssue` and `updateIssue`. Call `harvestFeature(projectRoot, record, ledger)`. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, inject signed labeled and closed issue events and a signed merged pull request event. Await the real harvest and assert HTTP 200, scoped issue and harvest rows, and zero `getDb` calls.
FIX: src/server/dispatch.ts — Keep ship execution errors separate from `handleCompletion` and call completion once, including when `startRun` fails. Set terminal dispatch and task state before `finishRun`. Guarantee worktree teardown, slot release, terminal journaling and queue advancement in `finally`. Retain errors before deleting settled promises from `inFlight` and surface them after `close()` drains the queue. Keep the `BEFORE UPDATE ON runs` trigger regression in `src/server/integration.test.ts` checking terminal state, zero active slots, worktree removal from disk and Git, and `app.close()` rejection with `fixture ledger update failed`.
FIX: src/server/dispatch.ts — Keep `persistDispatch(record, this.projectRoot)` before `this.queue.push(record)` in `enqueue`. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, put a directory at `.gwrk/dispatches.jsonl` and assert the failed request leaves the queue empty. Remove the directory and retry the same request. Assert one queued journal entry, one ship invocation and a completed record with the retry ID.
FIX: src/server/sandbox.ts — Propagate the final scoped `git worktree remove` failure with the worktree path and Git error. Call `forgetSandbox` after either removal attempt succeeds. In `src/server/dispatch.ts`, clear `record.workDir` only after successful removal. Retain the error for `close()` while releasing the slot and journaling the path. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, lock the real worktree before ship returns. Assert zero active slots, the retained terminal `workDir`, the on-disk and Git-registered worktree, and `app.close()` rejection. Unlock and remove the worktree in `finally`.
FIX: tests/helpers/server-fixture.ts — Keep `import { repositoryGitEnv } from "../../src/adapters/git/process-env.js"` and apply `repositoryGitEnv(root)` to every `fixtureGit` call. Preserve `GIT_EDITOR=true`, `EDITOR=true` and `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`. In `src/adapters/git/process-env.ts`, discover selector names with `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` in a clean environment and delete them from a fresh copy of `process.env`. Keep the setup regression checking the fixture’s `.git` and `Initialize fixture` commit alongside the external repository’s unchanged HEAD, status and local config.
FIX: src/server/index.ts — Keep `ScopedSandboxManager.gitOptions()` backed by `repositoryGitEnv(this.root)` and run prune with `cwd: this.root`. In `src/server/sandbox.ts`, apply the same options to branch lookup, worktree listing, all creation paths and both removal attempts. Keep `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE` pointed at the external repository through dispatch and teardown in `src/server/integration.test.ts`. Assert the fixture owns the branch and worktree while ship runs. Assert its worktree registration disappears after teardown and the external refs and worktree registrations match their original values.
FIX: src/server/sandbox.ts — Add `execFileSync` to the `node:child_process` import. Use `execFileSync("git", args, options)` for every `worktree add` and `worktree remove` path. Pass `workDir` as one argument and retain `cwd` and `this.gitOptions()`. In `src/server/integration.test.ts`, set `TMPDIR` to a temporary directory containing spaces and dispatch through the real sandbox with a successful ship stub. Assert the ship runs once, the journal reaches `completed`, and the worktree disappears from disk and `git worktree list --porcelain`. Restore `TMPDIR` and remove the parent directory in `finally`.
FIX: specs/046-hermetic-ci/gates/phase-01.sh — Keep `src/server/integration.test.ts` in the gate. Verify each regression fails with its corresponding fix reverted and rerun the full gate with all fixes applied in an environment that permits loopback binds. The diagnostic run passed 79 tests and failed two live-listener tests with `listen EPERM` on `127.0.0.1`.

  WHERE: src/server/dispatch.ts:159-163,232-239,266-330

  FIX: Separate outcome persistence from guaranteed cleanup. Release the queue slot and remove the worktree on every terminal path. Surface any unresolved persistence error and add an update-failure test.

  FIX: Append the queued record before adding it to the in-memory queue. Add a regression that fails the first append, clears the fault and verifies the retry persists and starts one dispatch.

tasks.title: Create server-fixture.ts
tasks.description:
NEW tests/helpers/server-fixture.ts. Compose isolated Fastify instances and own their temporary project roots and SQLite handles. Convert every server and route suite in the phase gate before running that gate with the quarantine lifted. Stub external calls and verify Git operations use only fixture repositories. FR-002.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Fixture Git environment probe — FR-002.
  WHERE: tests/helpers/server-fixture.ts:48-60,90-117
  EXPECTED: Fixture setup runs Git against the temporary fixture repository even when the parent process exports repository selectors.
  ACTUAL: env spreads process.env. With GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE aimed at a second temporary repository, setup committed Initialize fixture there and left the fixture without a .git directory.
